column1: # Pairs of presets measured as broken where a journey glides from the first into the second (Tools/presets/journey_transitions.py export-bad): more than 5 s of a minor second between the outgoing and the incoming chord (additiv_brain_audit --pairs --hold-pitch 1, every pair of the journeys), or a level dip or peak over 3 LU beyond both presets alone (empy_render --then, a sample). make_journeys.py keeps them apart.
